source.title: Which Seeded Legends Are Best? // Pre-Rift Seeded Deck Review
source.creator: Recycle2 Riftbound

summary: Video reviews all 6 Unleashed Pre-Rift seeded decks in detail: deck composition, notable strengths/weaknesses, cards to hope to pull and add (commons/uncommons only), domain pairings, and cards to consider cutting.

decks.champion_unit_notes: Conditional card draw every showdown (including moving into unoccupied battlefield). Card draw is premium in limited. Comes down early, 0 power cost.
decks.archetype: Spells + combat tricks + ambush units to take and hold battlefields
decks.spell_subtheme: Unleashed spells costing 4+ energy is a sub-theme — relevant for splash decisions
strengths: Rock-solid deck composition
Premium interaction suite (counter spell, damage removal, combat tricks)
Icefell Archer kills opponent's 2-drop most of the time
Crescent Dance: fantastic limited 3-drop, 0 power cost ambush, gives other units shield
Abandon: one of very few counter spells in the set, also fixes next card draw
Crescent Strike: damage-based removal + favorable trade tool
Starcross: game-winning in many scenarios
Abandoned Hall: perfect battlefield for the deck

cards_to_add.reason: Absolutely premium in limited. Good stats + removal that can target at base. Insane at common.
Amazing spell — double conquer or removal. Costs 4+ energy (a plus in Unleashed).
Great ambush unit from Fury domain.
Great ambush unit from Fury domain.
Move synergy gets really good with this card, especially from Calm domain.

domain_pairings.reason: Great ambush units (Inferno, Lord Broadman) and good damage-based removal.
Good combat trick spells. Move synergy excellent if you pull Blast Cone.

cards_to_cut.reason: Not bad — functions as 1-for-1 in most situations — but weakest link. Cut only if you need room.
Cut only if you open better top-end units and need room.
Card draw is okay but needs 4+ energy spells which is a tough ask. Cut if you lack those spells.

decks.splash_notes: Base deck is very light on power costs, so splashing Fury or Calm is pretty easy.

decks.legend_ability: Turns battlefields into Brush when you conquer or hold. (If a Brush becomes a Brush, it's Brush forever.)
decks.champion_unit_notes: Really good card draw in limited. Upside of buffing units if you play into the Ivan zoo condition (birds, cats, dogs, poros).
decks.overall_rating: Moderate — dependent on zoo tag density
decks.archetype: Zoo tag units (birds, cats, dogs, poros) leveraging Brush +1 might buff
strengths: Brush +1 might buff for zoo-tagged units is strong if density is high
Loyal Poro: card draw, very good
Stalking Wolf: excellent conditional ambush unit
Starhound: above-rate unit, retrieves Ultra Soft Poro; multiple Starhounds loop forever
Double Trouble: very good in unit-heavy deck
Soul Harvest: potentially good since early drops conquer → brush → +1 might bonus
weaknesses: Legend ability only functions with zoo-tagged units — restricted
Interaction suite is on the weaker side
Deck functionality depends heavily on zoo tag density and quality in your pool

cards_to_add.reason: Light Vanguard Armory + decent body. High priority if opened.
Incredible unit for the hold strategy.
Solidifies hold snowball.
Help defend held battlefields.

domain_pairings.reason: Towering Combatant for defense; Call to Battle / Imposing Challenger to move opponents into held territory.
Combat tricks and damage-based removal help the hold strategy.

cards_to_cut.reason: Great card but double Calm power is steep. Cut if going heavy into third color, or if deck is light on Calm power.

decks.domain_commitment_notes: You'll be hard-committing to Calm and Order for zoo tags. Splash a third color for interaction or high-value units without relevant tags. Consider making Calm your base color.

decks.legend_ability: Triggers when you cast 4 spells where you spend 4+ energy. Challenging to fulfill in limited.
decks.champion_unit_notes: Very good unit. Ganking is extremely premium in limited.
decks.overall_rating: Weakest — needs a lot of help
decks.archetype: 4+ energy spell theme, but very hard to enable legend ability
strengths: Jyn Murderous Artist is very good, ganking is premium in limited
Revn the Lawkeeper: perfect top-end unit, can be game-winning bomb
Deadly Flourish: amazing
Sprite Burst: one of the best limited spells in the set
Downstage Dramatics: acceptable draw spell in limited
Abandoned Hall: perfect battlefield for what Jyn shoots for
weaknesses: Legend ability (4 spells at 4+ energy) is very hard to trigger in limited
Prepared Neophyte is weak — above-rate sometimes < on-rate with relevant ability always
Most spells are conditional except Deadly Flourish and Sprite Burst
Battlefield is a considerable hoop for just a predict
No Mind power costs in the base deck — weird for a Mind legend

cards_to_add.reason: Best limited spell in set, hoping for multiples.
Actually decent in Jyn since it's a 4+ energy spell.
Premium limited inclusion regardless of archetype.
Premium removal.
Premium interaction/removal.
If opened, run as chosen champion — repeat 2 energy + 1 chaos power to all spells makes all 2+ energy spells meet Jyn's trigger. Too fun not to run.

domain_pairings.reason: Strongest interaction at common/uncommon. Most likely to contain the removal/interaction you need.
4+ energy spells already mostly in the deck from Fury + Mind.
Flurry of Feathers is a 4+ energy spell at common/uncommon.
Concentrate is 4+ energy but won't fulfill Jyn's condition if you have enough XP.

cards_to_cut.reason: Dies to Crescent Strike; above-rate sometimes is worse than on-rate always with a relevant ability.
Aggressive pushing tool only — cut if deck doesn't skew aggressive.
Average in this deck. Replace with higher value units or spells.
Average in this deck. Replace with higher value units or spells.

decks.strategic_note: Recommend not focusing on the legend ability. Just play best synergies you open. Exception: if you open Syndra Transcendent, go whole-hog on spells. Consider another primary color since the deck has zero Mind power costs.

decks.legend_ability: Provides XP versatility — engine (XP from winning combats) and payoff (buff units or allow conquer-then-return in same turn).
decks.champion_unit_notes: Probably the best champion unit among the precons. Constantly present and threatening to blow out opponent if they forget about it.
decks.overall_rating: Really solid — gets insane with lucky pulls
decks.archetype: Mid-range / tempo — uses XP as resource, not accumulator to high counts
strengths: Kha'Zix Mutating Horror: best champion among precons, constantly threatening
Damascian Diplomat + Mr. Root: solid early engine
Insightful Investigator: gross card, hope to open and run multiples
Megatusk: obscenely strong — stack one battlefield safely before ganking entire army
Isolate: balanced Fight or Flight with upside, rock solid
Solid synergy and interaction baseline
weaknesses: Grim Resolve is action speed — won't protect from damage-based removal
Don't fall into trap of running too many high-level-count units; don't expect to hit level abilities often
Battlefield doesn't synergize with anything the deck does — don't run it

cards_to_add.reason: Perfect for the deck. Level 6 bonus is nice.
On-rate and gives heaps of XP.
Best XP payoff at uncommon — 4 energy for 5 might with ganking is absurd.
Fantastic at common. Synergizes with battlefield and Insightful Investigator.
Great interaction tool — conditional charm to remove small unit when holding a battlefield.
Obscenely strong — enters ready at just 3 XP.
Basically Doran's Blade but equips for free.
Dumb body that gives incidental XP.

domain_pairings.reason: Natural gravitation for XP decks. Many level-mechanic cards, low-XP payoffs like Soul Sword, good even without level condition like Skyward Strike.
Better alignment with Kha'Zix than Calm. Bandal Hunter, Shepherd's Heirloom, Scrutinizing Sergeant at common are obscene.
Mega Tusk ready + army conquer + gank across battlefields = probably game-winning combo.

decks.strategic_note: XP as resource not accumulator. Body and Chaos have extremely good commons for what Kha'Zix does — putting together a reliable deck should be straightforward.

decks.legend_ability: Good buff at 6 XP. Game-winning advantage at 11 XP.
decks.champion_unit_notes: Becomes hyper-efficient 4-drop at 6 XP. Many alternative champion units can break the strategy wide open.
decks.overall_rating: Contends with Diana for best precon
decks.archetype: XP accumulator — get as much XP as fast as possible, never spend it. High inevitability.
strengths: Incredible inevitability — limited is naturally slow, so he does extremely well
Deck is basically perfect out of the box
Wynfish: obscenely strong
Gemhand Hunter + Wu Apprentice: solid role players
Herald of Spring + Voracious Gromp: push into higher XP territories
Concentrate: card draw, extremely strong at 11 XP
Combat Experience: almost always a better On Guard in this deck
Skyward Strike: premium interaction
Battlefield is perfect — exhaust units for essentially free XP
Has every good XP card in Calm and Body except Targonian Visionary and Grim Resolve

cards_to_add.reason: One of the best XP cards missing from the base deck. Slam it in.
The other best XP card missing. Slam it in.

cards_to_add.card: Doubles of any card already in the deck
cards_to_add.reason: The base deck is so good that duplicates are high-value.

domain_pairings.reason: XP synergy at common (Bandal Hunter, Shepherd's Heirloom, Scrutinizing Sergeant).

Obscene play patterns: Mega Tusk ready → entire army conquers one battlefield → ganks across to other = probably game-winning combo. Strongly consider Chaos as third domain if you open the right cards.

cards_to_cut.reason: Solid card but doesn't always align with deck's plan. First cut if you need room for better card quality or XP.

decks.strategic_note: You're looking to accumulate XP and never spend it. The inevitability at 11 XP is game-winning in limited's naturally slower environment. Focus on card quality and interaction over a third domain unless you open Chaos payoff.

decks.legend_ability: Readies units if you assign 3 excess damage in combat. Surprisingly tall order.
decks.champion_unit_notes: Ambush + stun a unit when attacking = extremely powerful pushing tool. So good.
decks.overall_rating: Weakest — struggles to fire legend consistently
decks.archetype: Hyper-aggressive, Fury/Order domain pairing. Assault units push but are vulnerable to counterattack.
strengths: Vi Peacekeeper: ambush + stun on attack = extremely strong pushing tool
Assault units are powerful pushing tools
Vi can ready units to move back to base, mitigating assault vulnerability
Square Up: makes retreat after attack highly likely
Smite: premium damage-based removal
Heroic Charge: premium combat trick
Lord Broadman, Ultra Soft Poro, Yeti Brawler: solid mid-to-top-end
weaknesses: Running out of gas is a significant issue
Legend ability (3 excess damage) is a surprisingly tall order
Sharkling, Arena Kingpin, Inferna: good sometimes, awful others
Ultra Soft Poro seems contrary to deck's aggressive gameplay
Battlefield doesn't align with game plan — units are horrible when holding
If you don't open Mind domain debuffs, you may struggle to find a good domain pairing

cards_to_add.reason: Strong + synergizes with Vi legend: conquer, ready, gank across.
Very good — craft a battlefield where units can deal 3 excess damage.
High priority inclusion if opened.
Desperate for card draw in this deck.

domain_pairings.reason: Most logical choice. Eclipse + Moonlight Affliction debuffs make overkilling trivial. Crescent Strike lets attack into damaged battlefield. Sprite Burst is amazing.
Moves and stuns can synergize with Vi's strategy.

cards_to_cut.reason: First on chopping block. Sizable tempo loss, vulnerable to Deadly Flourish and key removal. Compare to Heart of Dark Ice which was not good in limited.
Cut unless you have no other aggressive units.
Run blank battlefields over this. Doesn't align with game plan.

decks.strategic_note: Vi's legend is hard to fire consistently. Mind domain pairing for debuffs is the most interesting angle. Without those cards, finding another domain that pairs well is tough. In principle her legend provides synergy with aggressive archetype, so with the right pool she can make things happen.

cross_deck_observations: Diana and Master Yi are the top two seeded decks, contending for best of the lot
Jyn and Vi are the weakest — Jyn's legend is very hard to enable, Vi's excess-damage condition is surprisingly difficult
Kha'Zix and Ivan are in the middle — solid if you get the right pool, inconsistent otherwise
Sprite Burst is mentioned as premium across multiple decks — one of the best limited spells in the set
Ruined Rex is universally good in limited — slam it in any deck
XP mechanic (Unleashed) favors accumulators (Master Yi) over spenders (Kha'Zix) in limited
Chaos domain has strong common/uncommon support for both Kha'Zix and Master Yi (Bandal Hunter, Mega Tusk combos)
The 4+ energy spell sub-theme in Unleashed matters for splash decisions and Jyn's legend
Pre-Rift is casual — these reviews are for confidence, not competitive optimization
